ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 38 / OppVR58] Requires InSight Not In Proposal Explanation when Is Insight Being Proposed? indicates 'No'. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c, 'No - Using Hyland Software due to feature requirements'), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c, 'No - Using other IRM product'), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c, 'No - Price'), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c, 'No - Missing Feature'), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c, 'No - Customer has internal solution'), INCLUDES(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c, 'No - Other') ),
ISBLANK(InSight_not_in_proposal_Explanation__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An explanation is required when Insight is not proposed. Please complete the InSight Not In Proposal Explanation field.
